jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Role summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Finance & Accounts Executive to support finance and administration across all companies in the group. The role covers bookkeeping, financial reporting, compliance, payments and receivables, budgeting, and administrative visa processing.

Key responsibilities

Group accounts and bookkeeping

* Maintain accurate books and supporting records for all group companies
* Record and reconcile income, expenses, bank transactions, journals, and intercompany balances.
* Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records, including B2B transactions.
* Manage cheque preparation, tracking, issuance, and records in line with company procedures.
* Process and track coach payments, ensuring supporting documents and approvals are in place.

Financial reporting and planning

* Prepare organisation-wise profit and loss reports and balance sheets.
* Track revenue forecasts against actuals and prepare regular variance reports.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of financial models, budgets, and cash-flow forecasts.
* Provide timely financial information to management to support planning and decision-making.
* Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

Tax and compliance

* Support tax filings and related records, including UAE VAT and Singapore GST.
* Maintain compliance calendars and organise documents needed for filings, audits, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, tax advisers, and relevant authorities as required.
* Keep financial records organised and ready for review.

Administration

* Coordinate visa processing from an administrative perspective, including document collection, application tracking, renewals, and status updates.
* Maintain finance and administration files, ensuring records are complete, current, and accessible to authorised colleagues.
* Provide general administrative support related to finance operations across the group.

Requirements

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience in bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with VAT and GST processes; experience supporting multiple entities is an advantage.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets and accounting software.
* Strong attention to detail, organisation, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage confidential information and meet reporting deadlines.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate with colleagues and external service providers.

Success in this role

Success means maintaining accurate and up-to-date books across the group, delivering dependable organisation-wise reporting, tracking forecast performance, and keeping payments, compliance records, and visa administration on schedule.

Pay: From AED3,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
